ns0:list.ns0:item: A set of points in a rectangular coordinate system is the graph of a function if every vertical line intersects the graph in at most one point.
If any vertical line intersects the graph in more than one point, the graph does not represent a function.

The graph of a function is the graph of all its ordered pairs, (x,y) or using function notation, (x,f(x)) where y=f(x). fname of functionxx-coordinate of the ordered pairf(x)y-coordinate of the ordered pair
